source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseSavepointRollbackParityTest { @isTest static void rollbackRestoresLocalOrgSnapshot() { insert new Account(Name = 'before'); System.Savepoint sp = Database.setSavepoint(); insert new Account(Name = 'after'); Integer beforeCount = [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(2, beforeCount); Database.rollback(sp); Integer afterCount = [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(1, afterCount); Account row = [SELECT Name FROM Account LIMIT 1]; System.assertEquals('before', row.Name); } @isTest static void multipleSavepointsRestoreSelectedSnapshots() { System.Savepoint first = Database.setSavepoint(); insert new Account(Name = 'one'); System.Savepoint second = Database.setSavepoint(); insert new Account(Name = 'two'); Integer bothCount = [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(2, bothCount); Database.rollback(second); Integer secondCount = [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(1, secondCount); Database.rollback(first); Integer firstCount = [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account]; System.assertEquals(0, firstCount); } @isTest static void releaseDoesNotRollbackCurrentState() { System.Savepoint sp = Database.setSavepoint(); insert new Account(Name = 'kept'); Database.releaseSavepoint(sp); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'kept']); } }
